name: Yakuza Child
body:
You were exposed to the yakuza at an early age, for your father was a member of the yakuza, constantly in debt, frequently drunk, and often angry. You learned to remain out of sight, but you were always listening to the gang as they talked.

Benefit: You can speak a single Yakuza Cant and gain a +1 trait bonus to Stealth.
